name: RS graph-utility regression set
purpose: Frozen set of STRICT-matched functions with their real pre-match source states, used to measure whether memory-graph retrieval improves matching outcomes (arm A: gdlmem allowed; arm B: gdlmem forbidden). See tools/gdl/regression_set.py and record claim.method.RS_graph-utility-regression-set-protocol.
strict_definition: report.json fuzzy_match_percent >= 100 AND not pinned in config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json; reproduces the campaign's own STRICT count of 2574 functions at freeze time.
selection: From 4048 non-merge commits, 357 STRICT game functions carry a leading 'Match <fn>' commit across 60 TUs. 110 candidates (oldest + newest per TU) were MEASURED; 72 passed all three gates (HEAD exact, rewind clean, pre-state residual nonzero). 24 were selected by round-robin over residual class, preferring an unused TU and an under-represented era.
family_vocabulary_note: `family` is this manifest's own mechanism taxonomy, read off each closing diff; it is NOT the graph's 15-term residual-family vocabulary. `residual_class` is the measured fndiff class.
